2: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
3: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
4: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
5: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
6: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
7: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
8: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
9: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
